review_loop.review: /review-2 (two parallel read-only reviewers: bug-hunting debugger; architecture/quality/security/data-integrity auditor)
review_loop.verdict_before_address: Request Changes — 3 criticals (corroborated across reviewers), 8 warnings, 11 suggestions after dedup
findings_addressed: C1/C3 (corroborated): EvidenceCollector._current was set on the main thread and read on the worker — overlapping dictations mis-joined cleanup evidence. Fixed: job_started no longer binds; the worker binds via bind_current/clear_current; overlap regression test added.
C2 (corroborated): the log_transcripts persistence branch was dead code (ctx is never None) — transcripts silently stopped being retained under default config. Fixed: gated on ctx.collecting.
C1-CA1 (corroborated): prune purged retention_class='legacy' artifacts after 30 days and re-import could not restore them. Fixed: prune skips legacy; regression test.

Event writer: ValueError on a closed post-rotation file killed the writer thread (now caught + reopen-on-closed); critical spill bounded with dropped_critical counter; retention never manages another writer's pid-prefixed files; write-failure drops counted; single clock read per emit; new files created 0600 via os.open.
App wiring: store/collector calls on the hotkey and worker paths guarded so a store stall or evidence-write failure can never drop a dictation; retention pass moved off the main thread.

Envelope hygiene: no embedded transcript text (applied_sha256 only); prompt-less observations no longer mint empty model_input artifacts; cleanup_proposal join selects the main cleanup pass and excludes rejected proposals; on_failure applies secret quarantine; ASR decode params reference Transcriber constants.

Store: hot-path indexes via migration v2 (applied to the live store, backup taken); _purge_artifact commits the row before unlinking; close() tolerates a late writer op; composite atomic import ops (import_legacy_pair/import_legacy_text) close the crash window between artifact write and bookkeeping.
Importer: source identity hashed from the verified backup bytes; dictionary re-import semantics documented.
view_events: --last applied after filters; human formatting delegated to EventWriter.human_line (single S07 implementation, UTC/local toggle).

Tests added per reviewers: real-SQL unresolved_job_ids, on_failure (+quarantine), human_line UTC/local, capture_stderr content-free, torn-op rollback atomicity, migration-v2 index upgrade, interrupted-import convergence.
findings_deferred: mark/exclude recency guard on the latest example (user-facing nuance; noted for M09 review surface)
tests/test_stuck_overlay.py Harness.close() defined but not called per test (thread/tempdir leak within the test process only)
SQLite file is created by sqlite3 with default mode then chmod'd 0600 (sub-second TOCTOU window; single-user local machine)
